name: Silencer
effect: Damage halved (rounded down). Attacks do not count as Noisy or Loud.

name: Reflex Sight
effect: If AGI/GRA higher than the enemy, +2 bonus damage per attack.

name: Auto Reloader
effect: Attack and perform a Blade Action in place of a Reload.

name: Laser Accelerator
effect: This weapon ignores enemy Armor on damage.

name: Malware Injection
effect: Roll base damage 4 or 5 -> Stagger the enemy. If already Stunned -> +5 bonus damage.

name: Smart Aim
effect: Roll damage twice, keep the highest. Ignores cover.

name: Stealth Grip
effect: If first in turn order: first hit +d4 bonus damage. If in stealth: +d8.

name: Vibrating Motor
effect: If VIG higher than the enemy, +2 damage per attack.

name: Kinetic Engine
effect: Restore 1 (resource) on each attack with this weapon.

name: Counter Guard
effect: Spend 3 Energy -> reaction when an adjacent enemy attacks.

name: Heat Chamber
effect: Roll 1 or 2 base damage -> enemy Overheated for 2 turns.
